title: Immunity changes reproduction
hook: Two stated cases: explore the homogeneous perfect-immunity threshold.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the homogeneous perfect-immunity threshold affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Threshold, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the homogeneous perfect-immunity threshold in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: In a homogeneous toy transmission model with R0 3 and perfect immunity, what immune share makes effective reproduction at most one?
